svg.text: Memory in GiB. Solid = logged allocation / plan; hatch + est. = estimate. Dark area is NOT measured free memory.
RTX outlines: 96 GiB nominal, except compact = 32 GiB including headroom. Spark: 128 GB shared RAM, one worker per bar.
Startup / historical memory and throughput are separate observations, not peak telemetry. Host pinned RAM is excluded from bars.
